The Native Union Story Born out of a shared love of good design & quality products, we create considered solutions fit for the modern lifestyle. Always driven by passion, we work to empower others to live the same way. Igor and John, 2009Igor Duc and John Brunner, 2009 10 years ago, John and Igor met at a co-working space in Hong Kong. Sharing a passion for good design and quality products, they set out to challenge the perception that tech accessories are purely functional and uninspired. Together, they created Native Union. A decade later, we're now an international team with offices in Hong Kong, Paris, and Los Angeles, crafting everyday solutions for an audience just as global.

CHASING THE MODERN LIFESTYLE We believe in the positive force of tech to unlock more flexibility and freedom in the way we live our lives. Our ambition is not only to make beautiful tech accessories, but to provide considered solutions that elevate modern living, created with planet-friendly methods that make this way of life feasible for generations to come.

IT STARTED WITH A POP The launch of the first iPhone inspired our CEO & Co-Founder, Igor, to start Native Union. He knew it’d transform the way we live. Our first product, the Pop Phone Retro Handset, was designed for a more tactile and effortless experience when taking calls. Over a decade and many gadgets later, our needs have evolved but our promise stays the same – to empower your modern lives with tech.

Product Categories Charge / Carry / Protect We believe in ‘Less but Better’. Better design, better quality. Meticulously considering every detail, even those you might never see, for an Elevated Experience. Our commitment to using the best materials, plant-based and recycled whenever possible, ensures that our products not only meet the highest quality standards but also have a Reduced Environmental Impact See all Products Image to render iPhone Cases & Accessories Image to render All Cables Image to render POP Phone Image to render Desk Essentials

JOURNAL 3. A Fresh Face for our Brand A Fresh Face for our Brand NEWS # A Fresh Face for our Brand Every new year is an opportunity for us to reflect on who we are and realign on who we want to be. Last year, we redefined our brand purpose – 'Design for Life’ became our new North Star and now guides everything we do. This year, our visual identity follows suit. USB-C Simplified Reading A Fresh Face for our Brand 3 minutes Next Behind the Design: Year of the Dragon Capsule with Ray Dak Lam By Katch CamachoJan 11, 2024 Tags * NEWS Share Share Facebook Pinterest Twitter E-mail Share Every new year is an opportunity for us to reflect on who we are and realign on who we want to be.

Last year, we redefined our brand purpose – 'Design for Life’ became our new North Star and now guides everything we do. This year, our visual identity follows suit. The first time we refreshed our brand logo was in 2018. Characterized by the sharp edges and the uppercase typeface, this logo was fitting for a time when we focused on creating high quality cables and chargers in an industry of cheap and plenty. We most definitely won’t stop creating these refined power solutions we know you love (and we do, too), but we’ve since broadened our innovations in a way that we felt our visual identity had yet to encapsulate.

As we continue to commit to ‘Design for Life’ and as such expand our product range in new directions, we wanted a softer typography to reflect this more holistic approach to creating for the modern lifestyle. Our new logo remains minimalist in style but replaces the previous sharpness with a more rounded finish. Surrounding our brand name are nods to our roots, capturing who we are, where we came from, and where we want to go from here. Since our inception, we’ve been evolving to maximize the way you use your tech. Be it Qi-charging, MagSafe, or the rise of USB-C, we've found clever ways to integrate the latest advancements more seamlessly into your day to day.
